data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget to generate and render standard barcodes directly in the UI. Supports customizing layout options like width, height, colors, margins, and padding, as well as handling validation errors.
use_when: You need to display standard barcodes or QR codes in your Flutter UI
You want customizable barcode widgets with error handling and layout options
avoid_when: You need to scan barcodes using the device camera
strengths: Easy to use as a standard Flutter widget
Supports multiple standard barcode types and layouts
Includes error handling and custom error builders
